main_question: 在有限交互下，建立与实际能力匹配、且能支持任务组合的技能契约。
question: Does context-dependent selection outperform a single fixed grasp-offset candidate on this finite paired matrix?

layouts.geometry_origin: blocks_p0/test-a coordinates with fixed roles; historically exposed
blocks_p0/test-b coordinates with fixed roles; historically exposed

selection_rule: maximize development strict success, then minimize absolute offset, then protocol candidate order
conditional_feature: observed initial clear(support); scene id and injected condition are not selector inputs
notes: All candidates share complete clear(support) contracts, action inventory, goals and evaluation thresholds.
Offset is a world-z replacement added after oracle grasp_point and affects pick_table and unstack.
Geometry is reused development material; extension is a prospective run boundary, not untouched OOD evaluation.
Freeze global and two-bin observable-condition selectors after exactly 12 development trials.
Full-matrix per-condition best selection is hindsight diagnostic only, not deployed performance.
If a fixed candidate covers all conditions, do not claim context-dependent strategies are necessary.
An invalid trial stops the pilot; no automatic retries, threshold adjustment or model loading.
